description: Comprehensive initiative to bring BuildDesk construction management platform from its current ~95% feature-complete state to enterprise-grade, production-ready status. The platform has 943+ components, 264 pages, 186 edge functions, and 375 database migrations but scores only ~4.5/10 on enterprise readiness due to: TypeScript strict mode disabled (1,400+ any types), <2% test coverage, <2% accessibility compliance, no CI/CD for the main web app, hardcoded fallback tokens, and significant placeholder code. This PRD addresses all critical, high, and medium priority gaps across code quality, testing, security, accessibility, CI/CD, and production monitoring.

Create a script at scripts/count-ts-errors.sh that counts remaining ts-expect-error comments for tracking progress.

userStories.description: As an AI developer working on this codebase, I want AGENTS.md files in key directories documenting patterns, conventions, and gotchas so that future AI agents (and human developers) can work effectively. Create AGENTS.md files in: src/ (top-level patterns), src/components/ (component conventions), src/hooks/ (hook patterns), src/lib/ (utility patterns), src/pages/ (page patterns), supabase/functions/ (edge function patterns), and tests/ (testing patterns). Each file should document: directory purpose, naming conventions, import patterns, common pitfalls, and key dependencies.
acceptanceCriteria: AGENTS.md exists in src/, src/components/, src/hooks/, src/lib/, src/pages/, supabase/functions/, tests/
Each file documents: purpose, conventions, patterns, pitfalls, dependencies
Files are concise (under 100 lines each) and actionable
Patterns described match actual codebase conventions (verified by reading existing code)
Files reference key types, utilities, and common imports
No outdated or incorrect information
userStories.notes: This supports Ralph and other AI agents in future iterations. Based on actual code patterns found during this PRD.

userStories.title: Create progress.txt with initial codebase learnings
userStories.description: As an AI agent running Ralph, I want a progress.txt file initialized with key codebase patterns and learnings so that each iteration starts with useful context. Create progress.txt in the project root with a Consolidated Patterns section documenting: 1) Supabase query patterns (select, insert, update with RLS), 2) Component architecture (shadcn/ui wrapping pattern), 3) Auth pattern (useAuth hook, role checking), 4) Testing patterns (Vitest setup, mock patterns, a11y testing), 5) Build and deploy patterns (Vite config, Cloudflare Pages), 6) Common pitfalls found during the codebase analysis.
acceptanceCriteria: progress.txt exists in project root
Contains a 'Consolidated Patterns' section at the top
Documents Supabase query patterns with code examples
Documents component architecture patterns
Documents authentication and authorization patterns
Documents testing setup and mock patterns
Documents build/deploy workflow
Lists known pitfalls: TypeScript strict mode migration, any types, a11y gaps
File is under 200 lines and concise
userStories.notes: Ralph reads this file at the start of every iteration. Quality of this file directly affects agent performance.
